name: CoAtNet
plain: CoAtNet (Dai et al. 2021; timm's `rw` networks nano to 2, ImageNet-1k, some pretrained on ImageNet-12k): convolution stages followed by attention stages. Apache-2.0.
summary: CoAtNet (Dai et al. 2021) in timm's `rw` configurations: MBConv stages followed by transformer stages with relative position bias.

papers.title: CoAtNet: Marrying Convolution and Attention for All Data Sizes

task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: ImageNet-1k class logits.

variants.name: coatnet_nano_rw_224
variants.input_size: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 248) and centre-cropped to it

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original32.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

kernels.protocol: first call, 2 warm-up, peak reset, median of 1 rounds x median of 5
kernels.note: Existing CUDA kernel mode on one fixed input with five warm calls.
